query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND street != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_street, SUM(CASE WHEN (street IS NULL OR street = '' OR street = 'NULL') AND zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_zip_no_street, SUM(CASE WHEN zip = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_address_on_file, SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_fetched, SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active';
